mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 56 degrees and overcast near Badger Ridge Middle School with a waxing gibbous moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Overnight, temperatures will drop to a low of 50 degrees with no rain predicted.

The city announced that road maintenance for crack filling will begin September 28 across five zones, including areas like South Nine Mound Road and North Jefferson Street. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss new development projects, including site plans for Sub-Zero at Liberty Business Park.

There is plenty to do in town, starting with yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Plus, keep an eye out for the Verona Fall Fest happening on September 25.
Looking at the weekly report, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O W I, second offence, following a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
The Verona Culvers is currently closed for a remodel, so today's flavor is unavailable. They will also be closed tomorrow, September 22, for the ongoing renovation work.
